full_text:
Appendix 3
Enforcement Rule of the Act on the Promotion of and Support for Environmental Education [Appendix 3] <Amended on October 1, 2025>
Designation mark for excellent environmental education programs (related to Article 9(4))

1. Designation mark

![Designation mark as supplied in the source](https://www.law.go.kr/LSW/flDownload.do?flSeq=158953679)

Translation of the text and layout in the figure:
Upper arc: “Excellent Environmental Education Program”
Center: “Government symbol as shown in the original figure”
Lower arc: “http://www.me.go.kr”
First line below the circle: “Designation No.       ”
Second line below the circle: “Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment”

2. Content of the mark
(a) The designation mark for excellent environmental education programs shall be a doughnut-shaped circle, with the government symbol mark at the center. The designation name, "Excellent Environmental Education Program", shall be written above the government symbol mark, and the website address of the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment shall be written below it.
(b) The designation number issued by the Ministry of Climate, Energy and Environment shall be shown below the designation mark for excellent environmental education programs.
(c) The size of the designation mark for excellent environmental education programs may be adjusted.
(d) The colors of the designation mark for excellent environmental education programs (shapes and lettering) shall be the colors of the government symbol mark and black, and the typeface shall, in principle, be Gothic (sans serif).
